pages.text: The $(d)Thorns$() Gene can reflect melee damage while the chest slot is empty or holds Leather armor. By default, it has a 15% chance to deal 0.75 hearts and costs 1 hunger.$(br2)This Gene $(9)can be given to mobs$().
These are the default chances. Modpacks may change them.$(br2)3/8 - Bee$(br)4/16 - Pufferfish
